name: Caro Styling, Spread

ink.use: Text, primary buttons, rules, selected chips

tile.use: Behind cut-outs, the styling table, notes

emptySlot.use: Dashed empty slots and add buttons

terracotta.use: Missing pieces, Find it, warnings, small links. Passes contrast on paper

terracottaOnTile.use: Small terracotta text on the tile colour (4.8 to 1), like an open slot's name on the styling table. UI audit

onInk.use: Text on ink buttons and chips

placeholder.use: Example text in an empty field, like name@example.com (4.5 to 1 on paper). UI audit

details.note: Colours taken from the design files for small details, named so the app does not write them by hand. UI audit

drawingNavy.use: Drawn sample pieces, like the tee on screen 05

addingWaiting.use: Screen 06: a tile waiting its turn

addingWorking.use: Screen 06: a tile being cut out or read

tagPaper.use: The Your starting piece tag on the styling table

shadowBrown.use: The warm brown of the cut-out shadows, at the opacity each shadow gives

sand.use: Season swatch and the close marker, decorative only

brandPalette.note: Sara Caro's palette as the swatches appear (the hex labels on the original image are brighter). Indigo is not used in Spread yet.

screenTitle.note: One word in italic for emphasis

cutOutShadow.use: Pieces on the styling table and large cut-outs

parts.masthead: Profile button, CARO wordmark (28 high) centred, add button; then a double rule (1, 3 gap, 1) and a dateline in label style
parts.progress: Onboarding: 6 segments, 2 high, ink when done. Wardrobe: a 4 high bar
parts.credits: Numbered rows: number in display 18, 48 tile, name and 'For their ...', status with a dot (ink yours, sand close) or Find it
parts.disabledButton: A pill that cannot be pressed yet, filled or outlined: hairline fill, muted words, no outline. UI audit

copy: Sentence case. No em dashes, no emoji, no exclamation marks. Words: the edit, looks, get the look, to find, piece.
